import {mkdtemp, readFile, rm, writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import {fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL} from 'node:url';

import {bundle} from '@remotion/bundler';
import {selectComposition} from '@remotion/renderer';
import {applyWorkspaceEffectsAlias} from '../webpack-alias.mjs';
import ts from 'typescript';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
const projectDir = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const repoDir = path.resolve(projectDir, '..');
const entryPoint = path.resolve(projectDir, 'src/index.ts');
const typesGeneratedPath = path.resolve(projectDir, 'src/types.generated.ts');
// Sprint 5 rename: HypeComposition → TimelineComposition.
const compositionId = 'TimelineComposition';

const EXPECTED_ALLOWED = {
  _ASSET_ENTRY_ALLOWED: [
    'content_sha256',
    'duration',
    'etag',
    'file',
    'fps',
    'generationId',
    'resolution',
    'thumbnailUrl',
    'type',
    'url',
    'url_expires_at',
    'variantId',
  ],
  _CLIP_ALLOWED: [
    'asset',
    'at',
    'clipType',
    'clip_order',
    'continuous',
    'cropBottom',
    'cropLeft',
    'cropRight',
    'cropTop',
    'effects',
    'entrance',
    'exit',
    'from',
    'generation',
    'height',
    'hold',
    'id',
    'opacity',
    'params',
    'pool_id',
    'source_uuid',
    'speed',
    'text',
    'to',
    'track',
    'transition',
    'volume',
    'width',
    'x',
    'y',
  ],
  _THEME_OVERRIDES_ALLOWED: ['audio', 'generation', 'pacing', 'visual', 'voice'],
  _TIMELINE_TOP_ALLOWED: ['clips', 'generation_defaults', 'output', 'pinnedShotGroups', 'theme', 'theme_overrides', 'tracks'],
  _TRACK_ALLOWED: ['blendMode', 'fit', 'id', 'kind', 'label', 'muted', 'opacity', 'scale', 'volume'],
};

const FIXTURES = [
  {
    name: 'golden',
    timelinePath: path.resolve(repoDir, 'examples/hype.timeline.json'),
    assetsPath: path.resolve(repoDir, 'examples/hype.assets.json'),
  },
  {
    name: 'full',
    timelinePath: path.resolve(repoDir, 'examples/hype.timeline.full.json'),
    assetsPath: path.resolve(repoDir, 'examples/hype.assets.full.json'),
  },
];

const fail = (message) => {
  throw new Error(message);
};

const readJson = async (jsonPath) => {
  const raw = await readFile(jsonPath, 'utf8');
  return JSON.parse(raw);
};

const resolveAssets = (assetsPath, registry) => {
  const resolvedAssets = {};
  for (const [assetKey, entry] of Object.entries(registry.assets ?? {})) {
    const resolvedPath = path.isAbsolute(entry.file)
      ? entry.file
      : path.resolve(path.dirname(assetsPath), entry.file);
    resolvedAssets[assetKey] = {
      ...entry,
      file: resolvedPath,
    };
  }

  return {assets: resolvedAssets};
};

const loadFixtureProps = async ({timelinePath, assetsPath}) => {
  const [timeline, registry] = await Promise.all([readJson(timelinePath), readJson(assetsPath)]);
  return {
    timeline,
    assets: resolveAssets(assetsPath, registry),
  };
};

const importGeneratedAllowedArrays = async () => {
  const tempDir = await mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'remotion-smoke-types-'));
  try {
    const source = await readFile(typesGeneratedPath, 'utf8');
    const transpiled = ts.transpileModule(source, {
      compilerOptions: {
        module: ts.ModuleKind.ES2020,
        target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2020,
      },
      fileName: 'types.generated.ts',
    }).outputText;
    const tempModulePath = path.join(tempDir, 'types.generated.mjs');
    await writeFile(tempModulePath, transpiled, 'utf8');
    const imported = await import(pathToFileURL(tempModulePath).href);
    return {
      _ASSET_ENTRY_ALLOWED: [...imported._ASSET_ENTRY_ALLOWED],
      _CLIP_ALLOWED: [...imported._CLIP_ALLOWED],
      _THEME_OVERRIDES_ALLOWED: [...imported._THEME_OVERRIDES_ALLOWED],
      _TIMELINE_TOP_ALLOWED: [...imported._TIMELINE_TOP_ALLOWED],
      _TRACK_ALLOWED: [...imported._TRACK_ALLOWED],
    };
  } finally {
    await rm(tempDir, {recursive: true, force: true});
  }
};

const assertAllowedArrays = (actual) => {
  for (const [name, expected] of Object.entries(EXPECTED_ALLOWED)) {
    const actualArray = actual[name];
    if (!Array.isArray(actualArray)) {
      fail(`Generated module did not export ${name} as an array`);
    }
    if (JSON.stringify(actualArray) !== JSON.stringify(expected)) {
      fail(
        `${name} mismatch between src/types.generated.ts and smoke snapshot\nexpected=${JSON.stringify(expected)}\nactual=${JSON.stringify(actualArray)}`,
      );
    }
  }
};

const assertPositiveMetadata = (fixtureName, composition) => {
  if (!composition || composition.id !== compositionId) {
    fail(`Fixture '${fixtureName}' did not resolve composition '${compositionId}'`);
  }

  const metadata = {
    width: composition.width,
    height: composition.height,
    fps: composition.fps,
    durationInFrames: composition.durationInFrames,
  };

  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(metadata)) {
    if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) {
      fail(`Fixture '${fixtureName}' returned invalid ${key}: ${String(value)}`);
    }
  }
};

const main = async () => {
  const bundleLocation = await bundle({
    entryPoint,
    onProgress: () => undefined,
    webpackOverride: applyWorkspaceEffectsAlias,
  });

  const allowedArrays = await importGeneratedAllowedArrays();
  assertAllowedArrays(allowedArrays);

  for (const fixture of FIXTURES) {
    const inputProps = await loadFixtureProps(fixture);
    const composition = await selectComposition({
      serveUrl: bundleLocation,
      id: compositionId,
      inputProps,
    });
    assertPositiveMetadata(fixture.name, composition);
  }

  console.log(`Smoke bundle OK for ${FIXTURES.map((fixture) => fixture.name).join(', ')} fixtures`);
};

main().catch((error) => {
  const message = error instanceof Error ? error.stack ?? error.message : String(error);
  console.error(`Smoke test failed: ${message}`);
  process.exit(1);
});

1	import type {TimelineClip, TimelineConfig} from '../types';
2	
3	export const secondsToFrames = (seconds: number, fps: number): number => {
4	  return Math.round(seconds * fps);
5	};
6	
7	export const getClipSourceDuration = (clip: TimelineClip): number => {
8	  if (typeof clip.hold === 'number') {
9	    return clip.hold;
10	  }
11	
12	  return (clip.to ?? 0) - (clip.from ?? 0);
13	};
14	
15	export const getClipTimelineDuration = (clip: TimelineClip): number => {
16	  const speed = clip.speed ?? 1;
17	  return getClipSourceDuration(clip) / speed;
18	};
19	
20	export const getSanitizedPlaybackRate = (speed: TimelineClip['speed']): number => {
21	  return typeof speed === 'number' && Number.isFinite(speed) && speed > 0 ? speed : 1;
22	};
23	
24	export const getSanitizedVolume = (volume: number | undefined, fallback = 1): number => {
25	  return typeof volume === 'number' && Number.isFinite(volume)
26	    ? Math.max(0, volume)
27	    : fallback;
28	};
29	
30	export const getClipDurationInFrames = (clip: TimelineClip, fps: number): number => {
31	  return Math.max(1, secondsToFrames(getClipTimelineDuration(clip), fps));
32	};
33	
34	export const getTimelineDurationInFrames = (timeline: TimelineConfig, fps: number): number => {
35	  return Math.max(
36	    1,
37	    ...timeline.clips.map((clip) => {
38	      return secondsToFrames(clip.at, fps) + getClipDurationInFrames(clip, fps);
39	    }),
40	  );
41	};

12	def _read_env_value(env_path: Path, key: str) -> str:

14	        return ""

28	def fetch_reigh_data(
29	    *,
30	    project_id: str,
31	    shot_id: str | None = None,
32	    task_id: str | None = None,
33	    timeline_id: str | None = None,
34	    api_url: str | None = None,
35	    pat: str | None = None,
36	    env_file: Path | None = None,
37	    timeout: float = 60.0,
38	) -> dict[str, Any]:
39	    endpoint = resolve_api_url(api_url, env_file)
40	    token = resolve_pat(pat, env_file)
41	    payload = {
42	        "project_id": project_id,
43	        **({"shot_id": shot_id} if shot_id else {}),
44	        **({"task_id": task_id} if task_id else {}),
45	        **({"timeline_id": timeline_id} if timeline_id else {}),
46	    }
47	    request = urllib.request.Request(
48	        endpoint,
49	        data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
50	        headers={
51	            "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",
52	            "Content-Type": "application/json",
53	            "Accept": "application/json",
54	        },
55	        method="POST",
56	    )
57	    try:
58	        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=timeout) as response:
59	            return json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
60	    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
61	        detail = exc.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
62	        raise RuntimeError(f"Reigh data fetch failed: HTTP {exc.code}: {detail}") from exc
63	    except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
64	        raise RuntimeError(f"Reigh data fetch failed: {exc.reason}") from exc
65	
66	
67	def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
68	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
69	        description="Fetch canonical Reigh project data through the reigh-data-fetch Edge Function."
70	    )
71	    parser.add_argument("--project-id", required=True, help="Reigh project UUID.")
72	    parser.add_argument("--shot-id", help="Optional shot UUID; response stays project-scoped.")
73	    parser.add_argument("--task-id", help="Optional task UUID; response stays project-scoped.")
74	    parser.add_argument("--timeline-id", help="Optional timeline UUID; response stays project-scoped.")
75	    parser.add_argument("--api-url", help="Full Edge Function URL. Defaults to env-derived reigh-data-fetch URL.")
76	    parser.add_argument("--pat", help="Personal Access Token. Prefer REIGH_PAT / REIGH_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.")
77	    parser.add_argument("--env-file", type=Path, help="Optional env file for URL/PAT lookup.")
78	    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=60.0)
79	    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, help="Write JSON response to this path.")
80	    parser.add_argument("--compact", action="store_true", help="Print compact JSON instead of pretty JSON.")
81	    return parser
82	
83

95	            timeout=args.timeout,
96	        )
97	    except RuntimeError as exc:
98	        print(f"reigh-data: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
99	        return 2
100	
101	    indent = None if args.compact else 2
102	    text = json.dumps(data, indent=indent, sort_keys=False) + "\n"
103	    if args.out:
104	        args.out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
105	        args.out.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
106	    else:
107	        print(text, end="")
108	    return 0

urllib.error\nimport urllib.request\nfrom typing import Any, Literal, Mapping, Tuple\n\n\nAuthScheme = Literal[\"user_jwt\", \"pat\", \"service_role\"]\nAuth = Tuple[AuthScheme, str]\n\n\nclass SupabaseHTTPError(RuntimeError):\n    \"\"\"Raised when a Supabase POST/RPC call returns a non-2xx response.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str, *, status: int, body: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.status = status\n        self.body = body\n\n\ndef _build_headers(auth: Auth, *, extra: Mapping[str, str] | None = None) -> dict[str, str]:\n    scheme, token = auth\n    if not isinstance(token, str) or not token:\n        raise ValueError(\"Supabase auth token must be a non-empty string\")\n    headers: dict[str, str] = {\n        \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\n        \"Accept\": \"application/json\",\n        \"Authorization\": f\"Bearer {token}\",\n    }\n    if scheme == \"service_role\":\n        headers[\"apikey\"] = token\n    elif scheme not in (\"user_jwt\", \"pat\"):\n        raise ValueError(f\"Unknown Supabase auth scheme: {scheme!r}\")\n    if extra:\n        headers.update(extra)\n    return headers\n\n\ndef post_json(\n    url: str,\n    payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None,\n    *,\n    auth: Auth,\n    extra_headers: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,\n    timeout: float = 60.0,\n) -> Any:\n    \"\"\"POST a JSON body to ``url`` with the given auth and return parsed JSON.\"\"\"\n\n    body = json.dumps(payload or {}).encode(\"utf-8\")\n    request = urllib.request.Request(\n        url,\n        data=body,\n        headers=_build_headers(auth, extra=extra_headers),\n        method=\"POST\",\n    )\n    try:\n        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=timeout) as response:\n            raw = response.read().decode(\"utf-8\")\n    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:\n        detail = exc.read().decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n        raise SupabaseHTTPError(\n            f\"Supabase POST failed: HTTP {exc.code}: {detail}\",\n            status=exc.code,\n            body=detail,\n        ) from exc\n    except urllib.error.URLError as exc:\n        raise SupabaseHTTPError(\n            f\"Supabase POST failed: {exc.reason}\", status=0, body=str(exc.reason)\n        ) from exc\n\n    if not raw:\n        return None\n    try:\n        return json.loads(raw)\n    except json.JSONDecodeError:\n        return raw\n\n\ndef rpc(\n    name: str,\n    params: Mapping[str, Any],\n    *,\n    supabase_url: str,\n    auth: Auth,\n    timeout: float = 60.0,\n) -> Any:\n    \"\"\"Invoke a PostgREST RPC by name.\n\n    Maps to ``POST {supabase_url}/rest/v1/rpc/{name}`` with the params dict as the\n    JSON body.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name:\n        raise ValueError(\"rpc name must be a non-empty string\")\n    base = supabase_url.rstrip(\"/\")\n    endpoint = f\"{base}/rest/v1/rpc/{name}\"\n    return post_json(endpoint, dict(params), auth=auth, timeout=timeout)\n"
}

1	"""User-JWT verification for the banodoco-worker (SD-022 + SD-034 identity).
2	
3	Primary mechanism: verify the user JWT against Reigh's Supabase JWKS endpoint
4	using `python-jose`. Confirm `aud=authenticated`. Reject without considering
5	the service-role on the success path — service-role lives only behind the
6	optional `verify_via_service_role_fallback` path documented for outages.
7	
8	Configuration:
9	  REIGH_SUPABASE_URL                — base URL for the Reigh project
10	                                       (e.g. https://abc.supabase.co)
11	  REIGH_SUPABASE_JWKS_URL           — explicit JWKS URL override (optional)
12	  REIGH_SUPABASE_JWT_AUDIENCE       — defaults to "authenticated"
13	  REIGH_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY   — fallback only, see notes below
14	
15	The JWKS URL canonical path is:
16	    {REIGH_SUPABASE_URL}/auth/v1/.well-known/jwks.json
17	"""
18	
19	from __future__ import annotations
20	
21	import logging
22	import os
23	from dataclasses import dataclass
24	from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
25	
26	import httpx
27	from jose import jwt
28	from jose.exceptions import JWTError
29	
30	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
31	
32	
33	DEFAULT_AUDIENCE = "authenticated"
34	JWKS_CACHE_TTL_SEC = 300  # 5 minutes
35	
36	
37	@dataclass
38	class VerifiedJwt:
39	    user_id: str
40	    audience: str
41	    raw_claims: Dict[str, Any]
42	
43	
44	class JwtVerificationError(Exception):
45	    """Raised when a JWT fails verification — the worker rejects the task."""
46	
47	
48	# In-process JWKS cache keyed by URL. JWKS endpoints are tiny and rarely
49	# change; a 5-minute TTL trades a small staleness window for hugely fewer
50	# round-trips when a worker is processing many tasks for the same project.
51	_jwks_cache: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
52	_jwks_cache_at: Dict[str, float] = {}
53	
54	
55	def _resolve_jwks_url() -> str:
56	    explicit = os.getenv("REIGH_SUPABASE_JWKS_URL")
57	    if explicit:
58	        return explicit
59	    base = os.getenv("REIGH_SUPABASE_URL", "").rstrip("/")
60	    if not base:
61	        raise JwtVerificationError(
62	            "Either REIGH_SUPABASE_URL or REIGH_SUPABASE_JWKS_URL must be set"
63	        )
64	    return f"{base}/auth/v1/.well-known/jwks.json"
65	
66	
67	def _fetch_jwks(url: str, *, http: Optional[httpx.Client] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
68	    import time
69	
70	    now = time.time()
71	    cached_at = _jwks_cache_at.get(url, 0.0)
72	    if url in _jwks_cache and (now - cached_at) < JWKS_CACHE_TTL_SEC:
73	        return _jwks_cache[url]
74	
75	    client = http or httpx.Client(timeout=10)
76	    try:
77	        resp = client.get(url)
78	        resp.raise_for_status()
79	        data = resp.json()
80	    except (httpx.HTTPError, ValueError) as exc:
81	        raise JwtVerificationError(f"Failed to fetch JWKS from {url}: {exc}") from exc
82	    finally:
83	        if http is None:
84	            client.close()
85	
86	    if not isinstance(data, dict) or "keys" not in data:
87	        raise JwtVerificationError(f"JWKS endpoint at {url} returned unexpected payload")
88	
89	    _jwks_cache[url] = data
90	    _jwks_cache_at[url] = now
91	    return data
92	
93	
94	def verify_user_jwt(
95	    token: str,
96	    *,
97	    audience: Optional[str] = None,
98	    jwks_url: Optional[str] = None,
99	    http: Optional[httpx.Client] = None,
100	) -> VerifiedJwt:
101	    """Verify a Reigh user JWT using JWKS.
102	
103	    Returns a VerifiedJwt on success; raises JwtVerificationError on any
104	    failure mode (bad signature, wrong audience, missing sub, JWKS fetch
105	    failed). Worker callers should reject the task with code `auth_failed`.
106	    """
107	    if not token or not isinstance(token, str):
108	        raise JwtVerificationError("token must be a non-empty string")
109	
110	    expected_audience = audience or os.getenv(
111	        "REIGH_SUPABASE_JWT_AUDIENCE", DEFAULT_AUDIENCE
112	    )
113	    url = jwks_url or _resolve_jwks_url()
114	    jwks = _fetch_jwks(url, http=http)
115	
116	    try:
117	        unverified_header = jwt.get_unverified_header(token)
118	    except JWTError as exc:
119	        raise JwtVerificationError(f"Malformed JWT header: {exc}") from exc
120	
121	    kid = unverified_header.get("kid")
122	    matching_key: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
123	    for key in jwks.get("keys", []):
124	        if not isinstance(key, dict):
125	            continue
126	        if key.get("kid") == kid or kid is None:
127	            matching_key = key
128	            break
129	    if matching_key is None:
130	        raise JwtVerificationError(f"No JWKS key matched JWT kid={kid!r}")
131	
132	    try:
133	        claims = jwt.decode(
134	            token,
135	            matching_key,
136	            algorithms=[matching_key.get("alg") or unverified_header.get("alg") or "RS256"],
137	            audience=expected_audience,
138	            options={"verify_aud": True, "verify_signature": True, "verify_exp": True},
139	        )
140	    except JWTError as exc:
141	        raise JwtVerificationError(f"JWT signature/claims verification failed: {exc}") from exc
142	
143	    if not isinstance(claims, dict):
144	        raise JwtVerificationError("Decoded JWT did not yield a claims object")
145	
146	    user_id = claims.get("sub")
147	    if not isinstance(user_id, str) or not user_id.strip():
148	        raise JwtVerificationError("JWT missing required 'sub' claim")
149	
150	    aud_claim = claims.get("aud")
151	    audience_str = (
152	        aud_claim
153	        if isinstance(aud_claim, str)
154	        else (aud_claim[0] if isinstance(aud_claim, list) and aud_claim else "")
155	    )
156	
157	    return VerifiedJwt(user_id=user_id, audience=audience_str, raw_claims=claims)
158

161	    token: str,
162	    *,
163	    http: Optional[httpx.Client] = None,

165	    """SD-022 fallback path — only used when JWKS fetch fails.
166	
167	    NOT optimized in v1 (per sprint brief: "Document but don't optimize the
168	    fallback"). This calls Reigh's service-role-protected /auth/v1/user
169	    endpoint with the user JWT to confirm identity. Production code should
170	    prefer the JWKS path; reach this function only when JWKS is unreachable.
171	    """
172	    base = os.getenv("REIGH_SUPABASE_URL", "").rstrip("/")
173	    service_role = os.getenv("REIGH_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")
174	    if not base or not service_role:
175	        raise JwtVerificationError(
176	            "Service-role fallback requires REIGH_SUPABASE_URL + "
177	            "REIGH_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY"
178	        )
179	
180	    url = f"{base}/auth/v1/user"
181	    headers = {
182	        "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",
183	        "apikey": service_role,
184	    }
185	    client = http or httpx.Client(timeout=10)

187	        resp = client.get(url, headers=headers)

189	            raise JwtVerificationError(
190	                f"Service-role fallback rejected token: {resp.status_code} {resp.text[:200]}"

192	        data = resp.json()
193	    except (httpx.HTTPError, ValueError) as exc:

195	    finally:

200	    if not isinstance(user_id, str) or not user_id.strip():
201	        raise JwtVerificationError(

203	        )
204	    return VerifiedJwt(user_id=user_id, audience=DEFAULT_AUDIENCE, raw_claims=data)

17	def build_parser():
18	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
19	        description="Copy hype.timeline.json + hype.assets.json for manual handoff into reigh-app-compatible locations.",
20	        epilog=(
21	            "Asset path limitation: hype.assets.json keeps local absolute paths from cut.py. "
22	            "reigh-app's SupabaseDataProvider resolves asset `file` values as HTTP URLs or "
23	            "timeline-assets bucket keys, so local paths must be replaced after upload or self-hosting."
24	        ),
25	        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
26	    )
27	    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True, help="Directory containing hype.timeline.json and hype.assets.json.")
28	    parser.add_argument("--reigh-app", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_REIGH_APP, help=f"Path to the reigh-app checkout. Default: {DEFAULT_REIGH_APP}")
29	    parser.add_argument("--copy-to", type=Path, help="Copy the JSON files into this directory instead of probing reigh-app.")
30	    parser.add_argument("--name", default="hype", help="Name used when probing a file-based demo folder.")
31	    parser.add_argument("--print-sql", action="store_true", help="Print an UPSERT template for public.timelines. The bridge never opens a Supabase connection.")
32	    parser.add_argument("--timeline-id", required=True, help="UUID for public.timelines.id. Required; no default is generated.")
33	    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Show the intended action without writing files.")
34	    return parser
35	
36	
37	def source_paths(out_dir):
38	    timeline_path = out_dir.resolve() / "hype.timeline.json"
39	    assets_path = out_dir.resolve() / "hype.assets.json"
40	    missing = [str(path) for path in (timeline_path, assets_path) if not path.is_file()]
41	    if missing:
42	        print(f"open_in_reigh.py: missing required output file(s): {', '.join(missing)}", file=sys.stderr)
43	        return None, None
44	    return timeline_path, assets_path
45	
46	
47	def probe_target(args):
48	    if args.copy_to:
49	        return args.copy_to.resolve()
50	    base = args.reigh_app.resolve()
51	    for rel in PROBE_DIRS:
52	        candidate = base / rel
53	        if candidate.is_dir():
54	            return candidate / args.name
55	    return None
56	
57	
58	def print_copy_plan(timeline_path, assets_path, target, dry_run):
59	    label = "Would copy" if dry_run else "Copied"
60	    print(f"{label} {timeline_path} -> {target / timeline_path.name}")
61	    print(f"{label} {assets_path} -> {target / assets_path.name}")
62	    print("Reminder: reigh-app's live editor reads timeline rows from Supabase public.timelines, not these copied files.")
63	
64	
65	def maybe_copy_files(timeline_path, assets_path, target, dry_run):
66	    if target is None:
67	        return
68	    print_copy_plan(timeline_path, assets_path, target, dry_run)
69	    if dry_run:
70	        return
71	    target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
72	    shutil.copyfile(timeline_path, target / timeline_path.name)
73	    shutil.copyfile(assets_path, target / assets_path.name)
74	
75	
76	def print_manual_handoff(args):
77	    print(
78	        "\n".join(
79	            [
80	                "No file-backed reigh-app import directory was found.",
81	                "reigh-app stores timeline data in public.timelines rows with config + asset_registry columns.",
82	                "Provider reference: reigh-app/src/tools/video-editor/data/SupabaseDataProvider.ts",
83	                "Manual handoff options:",
84	                "1. Paste the SQL below into the Supabase dashboard SQL editor after filling <PROJECT_ID> and <USER_ID>.",
85	                "2. Rerun with --print-sql for the ready INSERT ... ON CONFLICT statement.",
86	                "3. Rerun with --copy-to DIR if you still want byte-preserved file copies for reference.",
87	                "ASSET PATH LIMITATION:",
88	                "hype.assets.json contains local absolute paths from cut.py.",
89	                "SupabaseDataProvider resolves asset `file` values only as HTTP URLs or timeline-assets bucket keys.",
90	                "Upload media to the timeline-assets bucket or self-host it, then update each asset `file` value before the timeline will play.",
91	            ]
92	        )
93	    )
94	
95	
96	def load_json_blob(path):
97	    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
98	
99	
100	def load_timeline_blob(path):
101	    return Timeline.load(path).to_json_data()
102	
103	
104	def sql_json_literal(obj):
105	    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False).replace("'", "''")
106	
107	
108	def print_sql(args, timeline_path, assets_path):
109	    timeline_blob = sql_json_literal(load_timeline_blob(timeline_path))
110	    assets_blob = sql_json_literal(load_json_blob(assets_path))
111	    safe_name = args.name.replace("'", "''")
112	    print("SQL template only: fill <PROJECT_ID> and <USER_ID> yourself. This bridge does NOT open a Supabase connection.")
113	    print(
114	        "INSERT INTO public.timelines (id, config, asset_registry, project_id, user_id, name) "
115	        f"VALUES ('{args.timeline_id}', '{timeline_blob}'::jsonb, '{assets_blob}'::jsonb, '<PROJECT_ID>', '<USER_ID>', '{safe_name}') "
116	        "ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET config = EXCLUDED.config, asset_registry = EXCLUDED.asset_registry;"
117	    )
118	
119	
120	def main(argv=None):
121	    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
122	    timeline_path, assets_path = source_paths(args.out)
123	    if timeline_path is None or assets_path is None:
124	        return 1
125	    target = probe_target(args)
126	    if target is not None:
127	        maybe_copy_files(timeline_path, assets_path, target, args.dry_run)
128	    else:
129	        print_manual_handoff(args)
130	    if args.print_sql:
131	        print_sql(args, timeline_path, assets_path)
132	    return 0
133	
134	
135	if __name__ == "__main__":
136	    raise SystemExit(main())

58	def show_project(slug: str, *, root: str | Path | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:

60	    timeline = load_project_timeline(slug, root=root)
61	    source_root = paths.sources_dir(slug, root=root)
62	    run_root = paths.runs_dir(slug, root=root)
63	    sources = sorted(path.name for path in source_root.iterdir() if (path / "source.json").exists()) if source_root.exists() else []
64	    runs = sorted(path.name for path in run_root.iterdir() if (path / "run.json").exists()) if run_root.exists() else []
65	    return {
66	        "project": project,
67	        "root": str(paths.project_dir(slug, root=root)),
68	        "runs": runs,
69	        "sources": sources,
70	        "timeline": {
71	            "placements": len(timeline.get("placements", [])),
72	            "tracks": len(timeline.get("tracks", [])),
73	        },
74	    }
75	
76	
77	def _touch_project(slug: str, *, root: str | Path | None = None) -> None:
78	    payload = load_project(slug, root=root)
79	    payload["updated_at"] = utc_now_iso()
80	    write_json_atomic(paths.project_json_path(slug, root=root), validate_project(payload))

249	def validate_placement(raw: Any, *, path: str = "placement") -> dict[str, Any]:
250	    data = _require_mapping(raw, path)
251	    payload = dict(data)
252	    payload["id"] = validate_placement_id(_require_string(data.get("id"), f"{path}.id"))
253	    payload["track"] = _require_string(data.get("track"), f"{path}.track")
254	    payload["at"] = _require_number(data.get("at"), f"{path}.at")
255	    if payload["at"] < 0:
256	        raise ProjectValidationError(f"{path}.at must be greater than or equal to 0")
257	    payload["source"] = validate_reference(data.get("source"), path=f"{path}.source")
258	    if "from" in payload:
259	        payload["from"] = _require_number(payload["from"], f"{path}.from")
260	        if payload["from"] < 0:
261	            raise ProjectValidationError(f"{path}.from must be greater than or equal to 0")
262	    if "to" in payload:
263	        payload["to"] = _require_number(payload["to"], f"{path}.to")
264	        trim_from = payload.get("from", 0)
265	        if payload["to"] <= trim_from:
266	            raise ProjectValidationError(f"{path}.to must be greater than {path}.from")
267	    if "effects" in payload and not isinstance(payload["effects"], list):
268	        raise ProjectValidationError(f"{path}.effects must be a list")
269	    if "params" in payload and not isinstance(payload["params"], dict):
270	        raise ProjectValidationError(f"{path}.params must be an object")
271	    return payload

274	def validate_reference(raw: Any, *, path: str = "source") -> dict[str, Any]:
275	    data = _require_mapping(raw, path)
276	    kind = _require_string(data.get("kind"), f"{path}.kind")
277	    if kind not in REF_KINDS:
278	        raise ProjectValidationError(f"{path}.kind must be one of {sorted(REF_KINDS)}")
279	    if kind == "source":
280	        return {"id": validate_source_id(_require_string(data.get("id"), f"{path}.id")), "kind": "source"}
281	    ref = {"clip_id": _require_string(data.get("clip_id"), f"{path}.clip_id"), "kind": "run", "run_id": validate_run_id(data.get("run_id"))}
282	    return ref
283	
284	
285	def validate_source_kind(raw: Any, *, path: str = "source.kind") -> str:
286	    kind = _require_string(raw, path)
287	    if kind not in SOURCE_KINDS:
288	        raise ProjectValidationError(f"{path} must be one of {sorted(SOURCE_KINDS)}")
289	    return kind
290	
291	
292	def _infer_source_kind(asset: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
293	    asset_type = asset.get("type")
294	    if isinstance(asset_type, str):
295	        if asset_type.startswith("video/"):
296	            return "video"
297	        if asset_type.startswith("audio/"):
298	            return "audio"
299	        if asset_type.startswith("image/"):
300	            return "image"
301	    return "other"
302	
303	
304	def _normalize_asset(raw: Any, *, path: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
305	    data = _require_mapping(raw, path)
306	    has_file = isinstance(data.get("file"), str) and bool(data.get("file"))
307	    has_url = isinstance(data.get("url"), str) and bool(data.get("url"))
308	    if has_file == has_url:
309	        raise ProjectValidationError(f"{path} must contain exactly one of file or url")
310	    payload = dict(data)
311	    if has_file:
312	        payload["file"] = str(Path(payload["file"]).expanduser().resolve())
313	        payload.pop("url", None)
314	    else:
315	        payload["url"] = payload["url"]
316	        payload.pop("file", None)
317	    return payload
318	
319	
320	def _require_version(data: dict[str, Any], expected: int, path: str) -> None:
321	    if data.get("schema_version") != expected:
322	        raise ProjectValidationError(f"{path}.schema_version must be {expected}")
323	
324	
325	def _require_mapping(raw: Any, path: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
326	    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
327	        raise ProjectValidationError(f"{path} must be an object")
328	    return raw
329	
330	
331	def _optional_mapping(raw: Any, path: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
332	    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
333	        raise ProjectValidationError(f"{path} must be an object")
334	    return dict(raw)
335	
336	
337	def _require_string(raw: Any, path: str) -> str:
338	    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw:
339	        raise ProjectValidationError(f"{path} must be a non-empty string")
340	    return raw
341	
342	
343	def _require_number(raw: Any, path: str) -> int | float:
344	    if not isinstance(raw, (int, float)) or isinstance(raw, bool):
345	        raise ProjectValidationError(f"{path} must be a number")
346	    return raw

print_manual_handoff():\n    print(\n        \"\\n\".join(\n            [\n                \"No file-backed reigh-app import directory was found.\",\n                \"reigh-app stores timeline data in public.timelines rows with config + asset_registry columns.\",\n                \"Provider reference: reigh-app/src/tools/video-editor/data/SupabaseDataProvider.ts\",\n                \"Manual handoff options:\",\n                \"1. Paste the SQL below into the Supabase dashboard SQL editor after filling <PROJECT_ID> and <USER_ID>.\",\n                \"2. Rerun with --print-sql for the ready INSERT ... ON CONFLICT statement.\",\n                \"3. Rerun with --copy-to DIR if you still want byte-preserved file copies for reference.\",\n                \"ASSET PATH LIMITATION:\",\n                \"hype.assets.json contains local absolute paths from cut.py.\",\n                \"SupabaseDataProvider resolves asset `file` values only as HTTP URLs or timeline-assets bucket keys.\",\n                \"Upload media to the timeline-assets bucket or self-host it, then update each asset `file` value before the timeline will play.\",\n            ]\n        )\n    )\n\n\ndef load_json_blob(path):\n    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n\n\ndef load_timeline_blob(path):\n    return Timeline.load(path).to_json_data()\n\n\ndef sql_json_literal(obj):\n    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False).replace(\"'\", \"''\")\n\n\ndef print_sql(args, timeline_path, assets_path):\n    timeline_blob = sql_json_literal(load_timeline_blob(timeline_path))\n    assets_blob = sql_json_literal(load_json_blob(assets_path))\n    safe_name = args.name.replace(\"'\", \"''\")\n    print(\"SQL template only: fill <PROJECT_ID> and <USER_ID> yourself. This bridge does NOT open a Supabase connection.\")\n    print(\n        \"INSERT INTO public.timelines (id, config, asset_registry, project_id, user_id, name) \"\n        f\"VALUES ('{args.timeline_id}', '{timeline_blob}'::jsonb, '{assets_blob}'::jsonb, '<PROJECT_ID>', '<USER_ID>', '{safe_name}') \"\n        \"ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET config = EXCLUDED.config, asset_registry = EXCLUDED.asset_registry;\"\n    )\n\n\ndef push_via_data_provider(args, timeline_path):\n    \"\"\"Default flow: SupabaseDataProvider.save_timeline with the local timeline as mutator output.\"\"\"\n\n    if not args.project_id:\n        print(\n            \"open_in_reigh: --project-id is required for the default DataProvider push. \"\n            \"Use --print-sql, --copy-to, or --copy-files to skip the network.\",\n            file=sys.stderr,\n        )\n        return 2\n\n    new_timeline = load_timeline_blob(timeline_path)\n    if not isinstance(new_timeline, dict):\n        print(\"open_in_reigh: timeline JSON must be a JSON object\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return 2\n    if \"placements\" in new_timeline:\n        # Pre-T10 placement-schema timelines are no longer pushable via the\n        # DataProvider; reigh-app's `timelines.config` column expects the\n        # canonical clip-shaped TimelineConfig. Escape hatches: --print-sql and --copy-to / --copy-files / probe.\n    handled_offline = False\n    if args.copy_to is not None or args.copy_files:\n        target = probe_target(args)\n        if target is not None:\n            maybe_copy_files(timeline_path, assets_path, target, args.dry_run)\n            handled_offline = True\n        elif args.copy_to is not None:\n            #   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env node\n// Renderer parity fixture exporter (T14).\n//\n// Reads JSON timelines from tests/fixtures/sprint08/ and emits a manifest\n// that pairs each timeline with its golden hash file. The intent is to\n// snapshot the sprint-08 helpers `createAgentWorkflowTimelineFixture` /\n// `createEmbedDemoTimelineFixture` from reigh-app's\n// src/tools/video-editor/testing.ts as plain JSON committed under\n// tests/fixtures/sprint08/. Once those helpers stabilize the JSON files can\n// be regenerated by exporting them via `tsx` and overwriting these fixtures.\n//\n// Usage:\n//   node scripts/node/export_fixtures.mjs            # report present fixtures\n//   node scripts/node/export_fixtures.mjs --json     # emit a JSON manifest\n//\n// This script never writes to the network and never depends on a reigh-app\n// checkout being present at any specific path. Missing fixtures are reported\n// as empty manifest entries, which is what the Python parity test gates on.\n\nimport {readFile, readdir, stat} from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport path from 'node:path';\nimport {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';\n\nconst __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);\nconst __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);\nconst REPO_ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');\nconst FIXTURES_DIR = path.resolve(REPO_ROOT, 'tests', 'fixtures', 'sprint08');\nconst GOLDEN_DIR = path.resolve(FIXTURES_DIR, 'golden');\n\nconst exists = async (target) => {\n  try {\n    await stat(target);\n    return true;\n  } catch {\n    return false;\n  }\n};\n\nconst listFixtures = async () => {\n  if (!(await exists(FIXTURES_DIR))) {\n    return [];\n  }\n  const entries = await readdir(FIXTURES_DIR, {withFileTypes: true});\n  const out = [];\n  for (const entry of entries) {\n    if (!entry.isFile() || !entry.name.endsWith('.json')) {\n      continue;\n    }\n    const fixturePath = path.join(FIXTURES_DIR, entry.name);\n    const goldenPath = path.join(GOLDEN_DIR, entry.name.replace(/\\.json$/, '.sha256'));\n    let goldenHash = null;\n    if (await exists(goldenPath)) {\n      goldenHash = (await readFile(goldenPath, 'utf8')).trim();\n    }\n    out.push({\n      name: path.basename(entry.name, '.json'),\n      fixture_path: fixturePath,\n      golden_path: goldenPath,\n      golden_hash: goldenHash,\n    });\n  }\n  return out;\n};\n\nconst main = async () => {\n  const fixtures = await listFixtures();\n  const manifest = {\n    fixtures_dir: FIXTURES_DIR,\n    golden_dir: GOLDEN_DIR,\n    fixtures,\n  };\n  if (process.argv.includes('--json')) {\n    process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)}\\n`);\n    return;\n  }\n  if (fixtures.length === 0) {\n    process.stdout.write(\n      `No sprint-08 fixtures present at ${FIXTURES_DIR}. ` +\n        'Snapshot createAgentWorkflowTimelineFixture / createEmbedDemoTimelineFixture from ' +\n        '../reigh-app/src/tools/video-editor/testing.ts and commit the JSON here.\\n',\n    );\n    return;\n  }\n  for (const fixture of fixtures) {\n    process.stdout.write(\n      `${fixture.name}\\t${fixture.fixture_path}\\tgolden=${fixture.golden_hash ?? '(missing)'}\\n`,\n    );\n  }\n};\n\nmain().catch((error) => {\n  process.stderr.write(`export_fixtures: ${error.stack ?? error.message ?? String(error)}\\n`);\n  process.exit(1);\n});\n"
}

  "content": "\"\"\"Renderer parity gate against sprint-08 timeline fixtures.\n\nT14 commits this gate as a documented skip. The sprint-08 helpers\n``createAgentWorkflowTimelineFixture`` / ``createEmbedDemoTimelineFixture``\nlive in reigh-app's ``src/tools/video-editor/testing.ts`` and have not yet\nbeen published as a consumable package. Until JSON snapshots of those\nfixtures are committed under ``tests/fixtures/sprint08/`` and golden hashes\nunder ``tests/fixtures/sprint08/golden/<name>.sha256``, this test\n``pytest.skip``s with a clear reason rather than failing.\n\nWhen goldens land, this test runs ``scripts/node/export_fixtures.mjs --json``\nto enumerate fixtures, hashes the canonical JSON of each fixture, and\ncompares against the committed golden hash.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport shutil\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nEXPORT_HELPER = ROOT / \"scripts\" / \"node\" / \"export_fixtures.mjs\"\nFIXTURES_DIR = ROOT / \"tests\" / \"fixtures\" / \"sprint08\"\nGOLDEN_DIR = FIXTURES_DIR / \"golden\"\n\n\ndef _node_available() -> bool:\n    return shutil.which(\"node\") is not None\n\n\ndef _run_export_helper() -> dict | None:\n    if not EXPORT_HELPER.is_file():\n        return None\n    if not _node_available():\n        return None\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [\"node\", str(EXPORT_HELPER), \"--json\"],\n        capture_output=True,\n        check=False,\n        text=True,\n    )\n    if result.returncode != 0:\n        return None\n    try:\n        return json.loads(result.stdout)\n    except json.JSONDecodeError:\n        return None\n\n\ndef _canonical_hash(payload) -> str:\n    text = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(\",\", \":\"), ensure_ascii=False)\n    return hashlib.sha256(text.encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()\n\n\ndef test_renderer_parity_against_sprint08_fixtures() -> None:\n    if not _node_available():\n        pytest.skip(\"node not available; renderer parity helper requires Node ESM\")\n    manifest = _run_export_helper()\n    if manifest is None:\n        pytest.skip(\"export_fixtures.mjs unavailable or returned non-JSON output\")\n\n    fixtures = manifest.get(\"fixtures\") or []\n    if not fixtures:\n        pytest.skip(\n            \"no sprint-08 fixtures committed under tests/fixtures/sprint08/. \"\n            \"Snapshot createAgentWorkflowTimelineFixture/createEmbedDemoTimelineFixture from \"\n            \"reigh-app/src/tools/video-editor/testing.ts and commit the JSON + golden hashes.\"\n        )\n\n    pending_goldens = [fixture[\"name\"] for fixture in fixtures if not fixture.get(\"golden_hash\")]\n    if pending_goldens:\n        pytest.skip(\n            \"sprint-08 fixtures present but goldens missing: \"\n            + \", \".join(pending_goldens)\n            + \". Generate goldens via the headless render path and commit the .sha256 files.\"\n        )\n\n    for fixture in fixtures:\n        path = Path(fixture[\"fixture_path\"])\n        payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n        actual = _canonical_hash(payload)\n        expected = fixture[\"golden_hash\"]\n        assert actual == expected, (\n            f\"renderer parity hash mismatch for {fixture['name']}: \"\n            f\"expected={expected} actual={actual}\"\n        )\n"
}

52	  const next = clone(timeline);
53	  const insertedClip = clone(clip);
54	  const length = next.clips.length;
55	  let index: number;
56	  if (position === undefined || Number.isNaN(position)) {
57	    index = length;
58	  } else {
59	    index = Math.max(0, Math.min(length, Math.floor(position)));
60	  }
61	  next.clips.splice(index, 0, insertedClip);
62	  return { config: next, changed: true, detail: { index, clipId: insertedClip.id } };
63	}
64	
65	export function removeClip(timeline: TimelineConfigT, clipId: string): OpResult {
66	  const idx = findClipIndex(timeline, clipId);
67	  if (idx < 0) {
68	    return { config: clone(timeline), changed: false, detail: { reason: "not_found" } };
69	  }
70	  const next = clone(timeline);
71	  const [removed] = next.clips.splice(idx, 1);
72	  return { config: next, changed: true, detail: { removedTrack: removed?.track } };
73	}
74	
75	/**
76	 * Reposition a clip on its track. `newPosition` is the timeline start time
77	 * in seconds (the `at` field), matching the existing
78	 * `ai-timeline-agent/tools/timeline.ts moveClip` handler. Naming
79	 * preserved per Sprint 3 brief: "newPosition" matches the signature listed
80	 * in the brief.
81	 */
82	export function moveClip(
83	  timeline: TimelineConfigT,
84	  clipId: string,
85	  newPosition: number,
86	): OpResult {
87	  const idx = findClipIndex(timeline, clipId);
88	  if (idx < 0) {
89	    return { config: clone(timeline), changed: false, detail: { reason: "not_found" } };
90	  }
91	  const next = clone(timeline);
92	  const previousAt = next.clips[idx].at;
93	  next.clips[idx].at = roundSeconds(newPosition);
94	  return {
95	    config: next,
96	    changed: previousAt !== next.clips[idx].at,
97	    detail: { previousAt, nextAt: next.clips[idx].at },
98	  };
99	}
100	
101	const MUTABLE_CLIP_PROPERTIES = [
102	  "volume",
103	  "speed",
104	  "opacity",
105	  "x",
106	  "y",
107	  "width",
108	  "height",
109	] as const;
110	
111	export type MutableClipProperty = (typeof MUTABLE_CLIP_PROPERTIES)[number];
112	
113	export function isMutableClipProperty(name: string): name is MutableClipProperty {
114	  return (MUTABLE_CLIP_PROPERTIES as readonly string[]).includes(name);

Exits non-zero with\n// a JSON error object on stderr if the op is unknown or the primitive\n// reports `changed: false` (no-op).\n//\n// Sprint-08 contract: AA's edit verbs (T11) shell out here instead of using\n// `createTimelineCommandRunner`; the primitives `addClip`, `moveClip`, and\n// `setTimelineTheme` ARE exported by the local package and are the canonical\n// authoring API.\n\nimport {addClip, moveClip, setTimelineTheme} from '@banodoco/timeline-ops';\n\nconst SUPPORTED_OPS = new Set(['add-clip', 'move-clip', 'set-theme']);\n\nconst readStdin = () =>\n  new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n    let data = '';\n    process.stdin.setEncoding('utf8');\n    process.stdin.on('data', (chunk) => {\n      data += chunk;\n    });\n    process.stdin.on('end', () => resolve(data));\n    process.stdin.on('error', reject);\n  });\n\nconst fail = (message, extra = {}) => {\n  process.stderr.write(`${JSON.stringify({error: message, ...extra})}\\n`);\n  process.exit(1);\n};\n\nconst dispatch = (op, timeline, args) => {\n  if (op === 'add-clip') {\n    const clip = args.clip;\n    if (!clip || typeof clip !== 'object') {\n      fail('add-clip requires args.clip object');\n    }\n    const position = typeof args.position === 'number' ? args.position : undefined;\n    return addClip(timeline, clip, position);\n  }\n  if (op === 'move-clip') {\n    if (typeof args.clipId !== 'string' || args.clipId === '') {\n      fail('move-clip requires args.clipId string');\n    }\n    if (typeof args.newPosition !== 'number') {\n      fail('move-clip requires args.newPosition number');\n    }\n    return moveClip(timeline, args.clipId, args.newPosition);\n  }\n  if (op === 'set-theme') {\n    if (typeof args.themeId !== 'string' || args.themeId === '') {\n      fail('set-theme requires args.themeId string');\n    }\n    return setTimelineTheme(timeline, args.themeId);\n  }\n  fail(`unsupported op: ${op}`, {supported: [...SUPPORTED_OPS]});\n};\n\nconst main = async () => {\n  const raw = await readStdin();\n  if (!raw.trim()) {\n    fail('empty stdin; expected {timeline, version, op, args} JSON');\n  }\n  let request;\n  try {\n    request = JSON.parse(raw);\n  } catch (error) {\n    fail(`invalid JSON on stdin: ${error.message}`);\n  }\n  const {timeline, version, op, args = {}} = request ?? {};\n  if (!timeline || typeof timeline !== 'object') {\n    fail('request.timeline must be an object');\n  }\n  if (!SUPPORTED_OPS.has(op)) {\n    fail(`unsupported op: ${op}`, {supported: [...SUPPORTED_OPS]});\n  }\n  const result = dispatch(op, timeline, args);\n  const response = {\n    timeline: result.config,\n    version,\n    op,\n    changed: result.changed,\n    detail: result.detail,\n  };\n  process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(response)}\\n`);\n};\n\nmain().catch((error) => {\n  fail(`ops_helper failed: ${error.stack ?? error.message ?? String(error)}`);\n});\n"
}

def test_executor_project_runs_finalize_success_error_skip_and_avoid_thread_collision(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    repo = tmp_path / "repo"
    repo.mkdir()
    projects_root = repo / "projects"
    monkeypatch.setenv(paths.PROJECTS_ROOT_ENV, str(projects_root))
    monkeypatch.setenv("ARTAGENTS_REPO_ROOT", str(repo))
    _clear_thread_env(monkeypatch)
    create_project("demo")
    registry = ExecutorRegistry([_writer_executor("test.writer"), _requires_executor("test.requires"), _skip_executor("test.skip")])

    success = run_executor(ExecutorRunRequest("test.writer", out="", project="demo"), registry)
    with pytest.raises(ExecutorRunnerError):
        run_executor(ExecutorRunRequest("test.requires", out="", project="demo"), registry)
    skipped = run_executor(ExecutorRunRequest("test.skip", out="", project="demo", inputs={"skip_me": "1"}), registry)

    assert success.returncode == 0
    assert skipped.skipped is True
    records = _project_records(projects_root)
    assert [record["status"] for record in records] == ["success", "error", "skipped"]
    writer_out = Path(records[0]["out"])
    assert (writer_out / "env.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "1"
    assert (writer_out / "run.json").exists()
    assert not (repo / ".artagents" / "threads.json").exists()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from artagents.core.project import paths
from artagents.core.project.project import create_project, show_project
from artagents.core.project.schema import ProjectValidationError, build_placement, run_ref, source_ref, validate_project_timeline
from artagents.core.project.source import add_source, require_source
from artagents.core.project.timeline import add_placement, remove_placement


def test_project_helpers_resolve_env_root_and_write_deterministic_json(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    projects_root = tmp_path / "projects"
    monkeypatch.setenv(paths.PROJECTS_ROOT_ENV, str(projects_root))
    media = tmp_path / "source.mp4"
    media.write_bytes(b"stub")

    project = create_project("demo", name="Demo")
    source = add_source("demo", "intro", asset={"file": str(media), "type": "video/mp4"})

    project_json = projects_root / "demo" / "project.json"
    source_json = projects_root / "demo" / "sources" / "intro" / "source.json"
    assert project["slug"] == "demo"
    assert json.loads(project_json.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["name"] == "Demo"
    assert project_json.read_text(encoding="utf-8").endswith("\n")
    assert list(json.loads(source_json.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).keys()) == sorted(json.loads(source_json.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
    assert source["asset"]["file"] == str(media.resolve())
    assert source["kind"] == "video"
    assert show_project("demo")["sources"] == ["intro"]


def test_project_source_and_placement_validation_rejects_bad_state(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setenv(paths.PROJECTS_ROOT_ENV, str(tmp_path / "projects"))
    create_project("demo")

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        create_project("../bad")
    with pytest.raises(ProjectValidationError, match="exactly one"):
        add_source("demo", "bad", asset={"file": str(tmp_path / "a.mp4"), "url": "https://example.com/a.mp4"})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        add_source("demo", "../bad", asset={"url": "https://example.com/a.mp4"})
    with pytest.raises(ProjectValidationError, match="source.kind"):
        add_source("demo", "bad-kind", asset={"url": "https://example.com/a.mp4"}, kind="document")

    source = add_source("demo", "intro", asset={"url": "https://example.com/a.mp4"}, kind="video")
    assert source["kind"] == "video"
    timeline = add_placement("demo", "p1", track="main", at=0, source=source_ref("intro"))
```

## After-execute user actions (require human action — not performed by the executor)

### U3 — Merge the cross-repo `reigh-app` PR exposing `config_version`

Draft PR: **https://github.com/banodoco/reigh-app/pull/6** (branch `codex/reigh-data-fetch-config-version`).

What it does: extends `TIMELINES_SELECT` in `supabase/functions/reigh-data-fetch/index.ts` to include the `config_version` column, and bumps the function version stamp to `2026-05-04.config-version`.

Why it matters: AA's Phase-2 DataProvider write path (`SupabaseDataProvider.save_timeline` -> `update_timeline_config_versioned(p_timeline_id, p_expected_version, p_config)`) reads `config_version` from `reigh-data-fetch` to drive the optimistic-versioning retry contract. Without this PR merged, the live read endpoint won't carry `config_version`, and `timeline_io.fetch_timeline` will fail with a clear error. AA's local + mocked tests already pass; only the live end-to-end validation is gated.

### U4 — Run the manual end-to-end staging smoke (success criterion #29)

This is a `drive_browser + observe_runtime_logs` test across three deployed services, so it must be run by a human:

1. In deployed reigh-app, trigger a `delegateToBanodocoAgent` task.
2. Watch AA's worker claim it via `POST /functions/v1/claim-next-task` (body `{worker_id, run_type:"banodoco-worker", worker_pool:"banodoco", task_types:["banodoco_timeline_generate"]}`).
3. Confirm in worker logs: `verify_user_jwt` passes against the Reigh Supabase JWKS, then `_verify_project_ownership` passes (service-role read of `projects.user_id` == verified `sub`).
4. Confirm `update_timeline_config_versioned(p_timeline_id, p_expected_version, p_config)` RPC succeeds and bumps `config_version`.
5. Watch `update-task-status` flip the row to `Complete` with `result_data={config_version, correlation_id, timeline_id}` (commit `ee2e6f10c`'s new column).
6. Confirm reigh-app's `pollBanodocoTaskStatus` reads the new `task-status` GET endpoint (commit `ee2e6f10c`) and that the UI re-renders the new clips.

Before starting U4: make sure `REIGH_SUPABASE_URL`, `REIGH_PAT`, `REIGH_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, and `REIGH_SUPABASE_JWKS_URL` in `.env.local` are real values (not the `PLACEHOLDER_SET_BY_HUMAN_BEFORE_T9` stubs from T16).
